glosses: to gradually steal everything from somewhere or from some whole

examples.text: To, czego nie rozgrabili Niemcy, rozkradli i zniszczyli sami Polacy po wkroczeniu bolszewików i reformie rolnej.
examples.translation: That which the Germans haven't plundered, Poles have themselves stolen and destroyed after the entrance of the Bolsheviks and the land reform.
